```sql
WITH j AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.order_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
v AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           variant_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS qty,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS rev
      FROM j
     GROUP BY product_id, variant_id
),
vp AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum(qty)::bigint AS quantity,
           sum(rev)         AS revenue_cents,
           count(*)         AS variant_count
      FROM v
     GROUP BY product_id
),
po AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_count
      FROM (SELECT product_id, order_id
              FROM j
             GROUP BY product_id, order_id) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       po.order_count,
       vp.quantity,
       vp.revenue_cents,
       vp.variant_count
  FROM vp
  JOIN po ON po.product_id = vp.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = vp.product_id
 ORDER BY vp.quantity DESC, vp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De zware sort van brede rijen (met sku, naam en merk) op product en order, die naar schijf spilde, is vervangen door hash-aggregaties op smalle sleutels. De distinct-tellingen worden zo via voorafgaande groepering berekend, en `products` wordt pas op het kleine aggregaat gejoind. De typen blijven gelijk (`sum(quantity)` wordt teruggecast naar bigint), en de join met `products` verliest geen rijen door de FK op `product_variants.product_id`.
